title: All-moduli Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.8733819666132079
description: Proves Dirichlet nonvanishing for every positive modulus and character when Re(s) > 8733819666132079/10000000000000000, excluding only the principal pole. The source G(1 - 10^-14, 2 + 10^-13, 0.15) and the five count windows are those of positive-reserve-selected-gap; the return is retuned to within 4e-17 of their fixed-count contact, with a deeper kernel-checked edge cover. The final theorem has no analytic or source-provider premise. Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, ArviFoxy, Sil and Jacob Sussman, including the PR93 selected sextic norm, PR97 selected-leaf energy and PR98 physical return. Inherited notices and licenses are retained. The development was AI-assisted.
